findings.problem: The plan declares the saved LCC outline as one of the builder’s three explicit inputs and requires byte-for-byte rebuilding from all three, but Increment D makes the builder read only the OpenAlex lists and tracked custom-shelves file. It therefore cannot derive or verify the outline provenance it must place in the snapshot, nor fulfill the stated three-input reproducibility claim.
findings.suggestion: Make the builder accept and read the saved LCC outline (including its source metadata/hash), validate the custom entries against it as appropriate, and emit its provenance in the snapshot; cover this in the builder tests and rebuild verification.

summary: One remaining reproducibility/provenance gap: the declared LCC input is not actually consumed by the builder.
